neighbours.label: Noun after a limiting quantity phrase ('a limited number of X', 'limited amounts of X'), vs the same nouns after large or open quantities
fire: The pilot program is open to a limited number of schools this year.
Visitors may bring only limited amounts of liquid through security.
The clinic can treat a limited number of patients each morning.
The soil holds limited quantities of nitrogen during the dry months.
Tickets are available to a limited number of fans at the gate.
The lake supports limited populations of trout in summer.
The shop stocks a limited range of tools for beginners.
The farm uses limited amounts of fertilizer on the upper fields.
quiet: The pilot program is open to a large number of schools this year.
Visitors may bring large bottles of liquid through security.
The clinic can treat dozens of patients each morning.
The soil holds plenty of nitrogen during the wet months.
Tickets are available to all fans at the gate.
The lake supports healthy populations of trout in summer.
The shop stocks a wide range of tools for beginners.
The farm uses generous amounts of fertilizer on the upper fields.
